evidence.question: BTC closes at or above its opening price

signals.basis: Six venues carry binary rows on testnet; only one hosts real DreamDEX event contracts. The others include a zero-volume pricefeed-test series.
signals.reading: The market operates on DreamDEX, the designated venue for event-contract trading.

signals.label: Resolution
signals.finding: Bound to oracle question 59823, not voided or superseded; settlement is publicly auditable.
signals.basis: Oracle binding, supersession, void state and settlement-window lapse, measured from `expiry + settlementWindow` (the instant `voidExpired()` becomes callable) rather than from expiry. Question wording is templated and identical across markets, and the docs warn against parsing it, so it carries no signal.
signals.reading: Settlement is tied to oracle question 59823, which is auditable and has not been superseded.

signals.label: Liquidity
signals.finding: Spread is 2.9 points on a 0.573 mid with 990 shares near the touch, in line with this venue.
signals.basis: Venue spreads measured 0.021-0.029 points (median 0.026), executable depth median 990 shares. Absolute points lead because a binary payoff is fixed at 0/1; the mid-ratio only catches the unplayable tail.
signals.reading: A spread of 2.9 points on a 0.573 mid matches typical venue conditions, indicating adequate liquidity.

signals.label: Depth durability
signals.finding: Quotes are short-lived but in line with this venue: the median resting order expires in 30s and nothing displayed is past expiry. 1984 shares across 8 orders, all of it owned by one address (proxy delegating to 0x8635C413B666eA8fcCf3BB302f7a7cE3988892a4, so the code deciding whether it can cancel is replaceable by whoever controls the target). 100% is withdrawable at will, none of it committed.
signals.basis: Per-order `owner` and `expireTimestampNs` from getAllOpenOrdersOffChain: fields every aggregated view sums away. Measured on all 10 live markets, twice: 1 owner holding 100% of both sides, 6 orders, TTL 11-28s, 0 shares past expiry. So a ~20s quote and a sole owner are this venue's normal and cannot be the alarm; phantom depth and a sub-8s TTL are the deviations.
signals.reading: Orders expire quickly (median 30 s) and are fully withdrawable, with one owner holding 99.8% of shares, which is standard for this venue.

signals.label: Volatility
signals.finding: Only 1 price bucket exists, fewer than the 3 needed to judge a move.
signals.basis: Close-to-close between consecutive candles (buckets are per-trade, so intra-candle range is structurally zero). Measured max step 0.096-0.130 across markets with enough samples, so ~10 points is this venue's normal.
signals.reading: Volatility could not be assessed because only one price sample was recorded, leaving price movement risk undefined.

signals.label: Staleness
signals.finding: Last trade 9 min ago, 1% of the window.
signals.basis: Last-trade age as a fraction of the market's own window. Measured median 0.040, p75 0.282, max 0.557. absolute age is meaningless across a venue running 5m to 24h series.
signals.reading: The last trade occurred 9 minutes ago, representing about 1% of the total window, showing recent activity.

signals.label: Window
signals.finding: 1411 min of trading left, 2% of the window elapsed.
signals.basis: Time to expiry, absolute and as a fraction of the window. Only `Trading` accepts orders and the transition is time-derived on-chain, so a market can lock between snapshot and action.
signals.reading: 1411 minutes of trading remain, meaning only 2% of the window has elapsed and most of the period is still open.

signals.label: Order flow
signals.finding: Only 1 fill recorded, too few to read direction from (any single-sided pair scores as total one-sidedness).
signals.basis: Taker-side skew leads because depth imbalance measured 0.000 on every symmetrically-quoted market, so it cannot discriminate here. Skew ranged -1.00 to +1.00 across the venue, the widest of any metric.
signals.reading: Order flow cannot be evaluated; a single fill was recorded, so trade direction is unknown.

rules.because: 2 signals could not be measured (volatility, manipulation), so this cannot be cleared for execution.

requiredChecks: Wait for more trades to establish a price history before treating the move as known
Wait for more fills before reading flow direction
